overlays.local_rules_that_may_remain: objective grading, access, fire and life-safety requirements supported by applicable authority
overlays.name: Hillside
overlays.preemption: cannot add unauthorized zoning/design standards to §66323 units or defeat the protected 800-square-foot §66314 floor

overlays.local_rules_that_may_remain: objective, ministerial grading or design standards within state bounds
overlays.name: Scenic Preservation
overlays.preemption: discretionary Planning Commission/design review cannot block a state-mandated pathway

overlays.local_rules_that_may_remain: building, floodplain, watercourse and FEMA/state safety requirements independent of zoning entitlement
overlays.name: Floodway
overlays.preemption: mapped overlay alone is not ADU denial or eligibility
